newsitem.title: USA: Utah 840 MW coal-fired unit maintenance set Apr 5.
newsitem.headline: Utah 840 MW coal-fired unit maintenance set Apr 5.

text.p: The 840 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the Intermountain coal-fired power plant in Delta, Utah, will close for planned maintenance April 5, a plant spokesman said Thursday.
The unit is expected to be shut for five weeks, he noted.
Meanwhile, Intermountain has decided to cancel a week-long inspection outage which had been planned for the end of March for its 840 MW unit 2.
"We had a short maintenance outage earlier that took care of things," the spokesman said.
The Intermountain plant is owned by a consortium of mostly municipal utilities including the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power.
